title: Scoped team invite policies + audit trail + SSO enforcement
creator: Maya Patel
description:
Summary:
Implement a unified admin control flow for org/team invites that enforces SSO-required policies, domain verification, and email allowlist/denylist rules, and emits structured audit events for all invite lifecycle actions. This ticket covers backend APIs, RBAC v2 authorization checks, audit log schema, and Console wiring for org-level toggles and team-scoped invite policies.

Scope and goals:
- Add per-organization and per-team invite policies: allowlist domains, denylist domains, block external invites, require SSO membership to accept invites.
- Ensure RBAC v2 checks gate who can change invite policies (org-admin vs team-admin) and who can send invites.
- Domain verification flow: allow admins to add/verify domains (DNS TXT or email verification) and tie verified domains into allowlist logic.
- Audit trail: emit structured audit events for create/update/revoke/accept invite actions, policy changes, and domain verification events. Events must include actor, target resource, prior_state, new_state, reason, and IP metadata.
- SSO/SAML: when an org enforces SSO-only invites, invite acceptance must validate SAML identity provider membership and fail-fast with actionable UI errors.
- Migration/backfill: detect existing pending invites that violate new org policies and surface for admin remediation (revoke, re-send with alternative email, or convert to domain-verified invites).

Non-goals:
- Full UI redesign for Console; we will add incremental screens and toggles using existing patterns.
- Changes to external IdP configuration flows beyond acceptance checks.

Rationale and trade-offs:
- Centralize policy enforcement in the authorization layer (RBAC v2) to avoid duplicating checks across API surface. This increases initial work on RBAC rules but reduces bugs and ensures consistent auditability.
- Domain verification supports both DNS and email token flows. DNS is preferred for orgs that want wildcard subdomain coverage; email verification is a fallback for smaller orgs. Accepting both increases implementation complexity but reduces support friction.
- Audit events are verbose by default; we'll implement sampling for noisy orgs and a compressed payload variant for retention-sensitive customers.
comments: 2026-03-05 - Maya Patel: Initial ticket created after security review spike. Linked design doc and rough API sketches. Tentatively assigned to Ethan.

2026-03-07 - Ethan Morris: Prototype of invite policy API done (branch feature/invite-policies). Schema includes allowlist_domains, denylist_domains, sso_required boolean, restrict_team_invites boolean. Working on RBAC checks next.

2026-03-09 - Review (PM - Jonah Reed): PM feedback - need a clear UX path when a pending invite is blocked by new policy; propose 'Notify Admin' and 'Auto-revoke with explanation' options. Added as acceptance criteria.

2026-03-10 - Security review (Ava Chen): Requested that audit events include prior_state and actor_auth_method (e.g., SSO, password) and that SAML assertion metadata be redacted in logs. Marked security_review_required=true.

2026-03-12 - Console eng (Priya Singh): Console mockups uploaded to Drive and linked. We'll add an 'Org Invite Policy' card under Organization Settings; team-level overrides will live on team settings panel.

2026-03-13 - Ethan Morris: Implemented audit event emitter and added new DB table invite_policies. Open PR: github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/2345. Need API contract review and migration strategy for existing pending invites.

2026-03-14 - Maya Patel: Blocker - SAML IdP metadata variations cause acceptance checks to timeout for some customers. Running canary tests with improved timeouts and retries. Engineering to coordinate with SSO infra team.
acceptance_criteria: Backend API: POST/PUT/GET /orgs/{org_id}/invite_policies and /teams/{team_id}/invite_policies implemented and documented.
RBAC v2: Only org-admins can change org-level policies; team-admins can change team-level policies if 'restrict_team_invites' allows overrides. Verified with unit/integration tests.
Domain verification: DNS TXT and email verification flows implemented. Verified domains are stored and surfaced in policy evaluation.
SSO enforcement: If org.sso_required=true, invite acceptance must validate IdP membership; acceptance attempts for non-IdP users fail with clear error code and audit event.

Audit logs: Structured events emitted for invite.create, invite.update, invite.revoke, invite.accept, policy.change, domain.verify with fields actor, actor_role, target, prior_state, new_state, request_ip, and request_id.
Migration: All pending invites evaluated during rollout. Admins are notified of invites that violate tightened policies with actions: revoke, resend, or bypass (audit only) via Console.
Console: Admin UI toggles for org-level invite policy and per-team override UI implemented and validated in staging. Feature behind FF: 'invite_policies_v2'.
Docs: Confluence doc + API spec and Console help doc updated with examples and troubleshooting steps.
Monitoring: Dashboards showing invite policy change rate, invite rejection rate, SSO enforcement failures, and audit event emission counts. Alerts for spikes in rejection or SAML timeouts.
